per13_durability_on_production_opener_at.classification_evidence: Opener-grade primary week-blocked estimate -0.8772 accuracy points with 95% interval [-2.3864,+0.4464] and probability_positive 0.084. This is unresolved_below_power: the interval is not wholly below zero, the underlying durability trait has measured split-half reliability 0.793, and the positive control detected +43.860 points with probability_positive 1.000 rather than bounding an effect at this scale. The binding taxonomy therefore supplies no admissible closing ground.
per13_durability_on_production_opener_at.description: PER-13 opener-graded confirmation: durability-augmented P(plays) replacement of the nine production weak_stack injury columns versus unmodified weak_stack, both market_residual/ridge/alpha10, on the rotation-assigned Tuesday-opener window [2020,2021].
per13_durability_on_production_opener_at.notes: Measured by scripts/per13_durability_on_production.py --mode screen --grade opener --seasons 2020-2021 --permutations 200 --bootstrap-samples 1000 --seed 20260826. The null ran first (200 within-week permutations; mean +0.1086 pts; observed at 3.0th percentile), then the positive control (43.860 pts, P+ 1.000), then this screen. Candidate 52.8509%, baseline 53.7281%, paired delta -0.8772 pts; home-pick rates 22.1030% vs 21.2446%; 2.146% picks differ. The opener child inherits the spent close family and acknowledges mined-season multiplicity. Do not pool with the close-graded per13_durability_on_production_ats row: same units but distinct grade/window and correlated lineage.
per13_durability_on_production_opener_at.plain_summary: At the Tuesday opener, the durability version changed the production model's pick on a small share of games and scored below the unchanged model in this two-season window. The opener result is unresolved research evidence -- it doesn't mean this version should replace what's currently played.
